hooks.name: Danger-zone: kredi atomikliği testi

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)" && echo '⚠ DANGER-ZONE #1 (kredi atomikliği). billing.test.cjs koşuluyor…' && node --test infra/lambda/tests/billing.test.cjs 2>&1 | tail -15
